name: Counter: opponent drops into 5-4-1
effect: Matches the overload on that side with an extra defender.
advantage: Reduces space for the right-channel progressive actions (6 since the change).
risk: Fewer outlets for the opponent's counter-attacks; their pressure on the ball drops.
limitations: Event data has no off-ball tracking: positional effects are inferred from on-ball events. No score prediction is made.
